newsitem.title: USA: Clinton sends "get well" message to Yeltsin.
newsitem.headline: Clinton sends "get well" message to Yeltsin.

text.p: President Bill Clinton has sent a "get well soon" message to Russian President Boris Yeltsin, who is hospitalized with pneumonia, the White House said.

White House Press Secretary Mike McCurry told reporters on Thursday that "the president had sent a get-well note to him overnight -- it was no doubt received in Moscow probably today -- just wishing -- sending President Yeltsin the best wishes of the president and Mrs. Clinton for a speedy recovery."
Yeltsin, 65, was hospitalized on Wednesday, two weeks after returning to work in the Kremlin following major heart surgery.
